_what_this_is: The Product half of the Factory's standalone_check.py (D-14). The engine is the whole installable project: pyproject.toml at the repo root builds the masterbrain + email_brain wheel.
_provenance: Written 2026-10-21 for WO-2026-10-21-1 item 5. source='.' because the buildable unit is the repo root (pyproject.toml); modules are the public package entry points; dependencies come from the wheel's own metadata, so `requirements` is empty. The probe hashes a temp file through masterbrain.datacore.dedup.file_hash and checks it against hashlib - a real computation with no repo, database or network underneath.

engine.compute_probe:
import hashlib, os, tempfile
from masterbrain.datacore.dedup import file_hash
fd, p = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.write(fd, b'masterbrain')
os.close(fd)
assert file_hash(p) == hashlib.sha256(b'masterbrain').hexdigest()
